ffe69cc2-3f9e-4eab-a7f7-c963cea9ec25.title: Hitoribocchi no Isekai Kouryaku
ffe69cc2-3f9e-4eab-a7f7-c963cea9ec25.altTitle: Lonely Attack on the Different World
ffe69cc2-3f9e-4eab-a7f7-c963cea9ec25.description:
The strongest doesn’t need any cheats! Haruka, who spends his high school life a loner, was suddenly summoned to another world one day along with all his classmates. When ol’ God enters the picture, Haruka believes he can just choose whatever cheat skill he wants to help him survive in the new world… But, contrary to his expectations, that list of cheat skills works on a first come, first serve basis. And so, his classmates pick out all the cheat skills. His choices now limited to leftovers, Haruka finds himself incapable of assembling a party due to his own “loner” skill. Even though it’s a different world, it seems his adventuring days will be, as per usual, a solitary affair… After becoming aware of a crisis looming over his classmates, Haruka makes a silent vow to save them. No relying on cheats! He will walk a heretical path of strength that transcends the need for them.  
  
The curtain rises on the strongest loner’s otherworld strategy guide!

91b67596-9bc3-48f5-8aad-02ff520fdfa9.title: Eoneu Mabeopsa ui Sikdang
91b67596-9bc3-48f5-8aad-02ff520fdfa9.description: A young aspiring chef suddenly finds himself in a world of war, dragons, and magic. These two worlds couldn’t be further apart... or could they? Who says you can’t open a restaurant in a fantasy realm? I mean, what could possibly go wrong? A perfect series for fantasy, magic, and food lovers.

173116b6-0f11-4fff-a348-8844d1394a45.title: Ore Dake Haireru Kakushi Dungeon ~Kossori Kitaete Sekai Saikyou~
173116b6-0f11-4fff-a348-8844d1394a45.altTitle: Special Training in the Secret Dungeon!
173116b6-0f11-4fff-a348-8844d1394a45.description: Noir Stardia, lesser son of an even lesser noble, just lost his job. Without a penny to his name, he decides to enroll in the Hero Academy and improve his career prospects. But he'll need to get a lot stronger to pass the entrance exam. So Noir seeks out a hidden dungeon—a legendary labyrinth filled with strange beasts and rare items—where he can train until he's powerful enough to change his fate!

32505911-558f-4ce0-9eed-0b4538f29efc.title: Dragon no I de Oyasumi
32505911-558f-4ce0-9eed-0b4538f29efc.altTitle: The Knight Commander Spends Her Days Off in the Dragon's Belly
32505911-558f-4ce0-9eed-0b4538f29efc.description:
The Knight Commander is a symbol of the country and the people's admiration. However, in reality, her role is merely that of a front-facing middle manager, where she is merely bossed around by her superiors. One day, while working, the proud female Knight Commander, Lienna, encounters a giant dragon. She tries to fight back, but is brutally defeated, perhaps due to fatigue from her daily hard work. However, the sight she sees when she wakes up is hard to believe...!?
___

83d429da-e807-4e72-9892-b6c7c617d446.title: Hinako Note
83d429da-e807-4e72-9892-b6c7c617d446.description: Hinako has trouble communicating with others. The moment she tries to speak, she freezes up and can't get the words out. In an effort to get better at communication, she moves from the countryside to Tokyo to attend a high school with a famous theatre club, only to find out the club has been disbanded! Together with new friends she meets at her boarding house, including a kind senior who was once a child actress, a shy girl obsessed with maid clothes, and a literary girl with a literal taste for books, Hinako's journey to take the stage and find her voice begins.

4911120a-723f-4c36-af98-00dc2b7b2f76.title: Tensei Teido de Mune no Ana wa Umaranai
4911120a-723f-4c36-af98-00dc2b7b2f76.altTitle: Reincarnation Isn’t Enough to Fill the Hole in My Heart
4911120a-723f-4c36-af98-00dc2b7b2f76.description:
In this other world, a person's deepest longing becomes their unique magic.

Adepts - transcendent beings who wield unique magic and guard humanity from the Evil Gods, are granted every conceivable right.

Konoe's past life was nothing but loneliness. So this time, he wished with everything he had, “I want to be someone's most important person.” And to make that wish come true, he went through years of brutal training, finally earning the title of Adept, all to attain the right to use forbidden love potions.

The one who came seeking his help was a golden-haired girl afflicted with a terminal plague.
___
**Character Designer:** [Isshiki](https://mangadex.org/author/14c2409b-3317-40d7-b51d-34f7e130b5b4)

bd19e205-27e6-42db-9e11-4a0ba82cf074.title: Normal Girl
bd19e205-27e6-42db-9e11-4a0ba82cf074.description:
Dear Ena,

Toukyou has way too many people, don’t you think!? It's bright all night long, so you can’t see the stars at all. I was honestly shocked. Well, I guess what’s even more shocking is that I, who was a shut-in all through middle and high school, suddenly moved to Toukyou to go to university. Also, when I got off at a service area during the overnight bus ride, I lost track of which bus was mine. But I still got here safely! At the station I even got an IC card and used it to go through the gate. That was pretty easy too!! Anyway, since I know you’ll be lonely with me gone, I’ll keep writing letters to you. See you again, good night.

From your big sister.
___

9660c79b-0b65-4f13-956c-03364651800b.title: Zense wa Kentei. Konjou Kuzu Ouji
9660c79b-0b65-4f13-956c-03364651800b.altTitle: Previous Life was Sword Emperor. This Life is Trash Prince.
9660c79b-0b65-4f13-956c-03364651800b.description:
He was called a Sword Emperor who lived for the sword and died by the sword. And his end was a tragedy. 

However, by strange coincidence, he was reincarnated as the third prince in a country. He was enjoying his lazy lifestyle away from swords and heroism. As a consequence, people began referring to him as Prince Trash.

He never cared about his derogatory name until one day, he encounters someone who gets the wheel of fate to move in motion.

30d47395-d3e2-4170-8d34-f6e53e9f4302.title: Shin no Jitsuryoku wo Kakushiteiru to Omowareteru Seireishi, Jitsuwa Itsumo Meccha Honki de Tatakattemasu
30d47395-d3e2-4170-8d34-f6e53e9f4302.altTitle: Spirit Master Who is Thought to Be Hiding His True Ability is Actually Always Fighting Very Seriously
30d47395-d3e2-4170-8d34-f6e53e9f4302.description:
"Spirit Mages" fight evil threats to humanity by borrowing the power of contracted spirits.

Roak Aleas, a second-year student at Utrea Academy, the training institution for Spirit Mages, possesses skills ranking second in his year. Yet, he has never once summoned a contracted spirit, leading the entire academy to focus on him, evaluating that he "must be hiding his true power." However, as for Roak himself–

"Why don't I summon my contracted spirit? Because I don't have any (—)!"

His strength comes solely from endlessly honing his swordsmanship and martial arts using the only spirit he can contract – a micro-spirit. In reality, he’s always fighting desperately just to stay alive...!? Amidst all this, he gets chosen as a member to explore the highly dangerous "Lunar Ruins"...!?

The Spirit Mage who everyone thinks is hiding his true power actually always fights with everything he's got. He’s not refusing to summon his Contracted Spirits, he just doesn’t have any! — this Spirit Mage is still too strong!?

*Source: Novelupdates*
